name: Google Chat
shortInfo: Google Chat helps workspace users connect & collaborate securely in real time.
brief: Google Chat is a Messaging app that lets users within a workspace connect and collaborate in real time or at any time to get things done.
about:
The Google Chat Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to Google Chat in an automated manner

You can check out our API Documentation [here.](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/google-chat/index.html)
availableSync:
[Message](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/google-chat/syncs/message.html)

[](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/google-chat/syncs/message.html)This sync can be used to request and retrieve data and updates on Google Chat from your data warehouse.
